subject: Request: VertaLabs MAP-linked deferred discount — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Samir Khanna <skhanna@vertalabs.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ayesha Roy <ayesha@vertalabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount

Olga —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Internal leadership asked us to pull together a clear MAP (mutual action plan) tying milestones to usage ramp. To secure the 24-month commit they asked if Redwood can provide a deferred discount structure: 30% total economic concession (applied as a combination of onboarding credit and usage rebates), with payment of rebates tied to hitting month-3 and month-6 MAP milestones (pilot success & 2M tokens/month).

High level:
- Commit: 24 months, minimum billing threshold of $1.2M ARR
- MAP milestones: pilot completion (M3), production ramp (M6)
- Request: 30% concession across term; prefer rebate paid on milestone achievement vs. upfront credit

They asked if we can put terms in a singed amendment and expedite — target close by next Friday 5/24.

Are you able to escalate internally for approval? Samir
VertaLabs — Head of AI Partnerships
[Attachment: Verta_MAP_v1.3.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Samir Khanna <skhanna@vertalabs.com>
Date: 2028-05-17 08:50
Subject: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Ayesha Roy <ayesha@vertalabs.com>

Team — forwarding Samir's ask. Quick summary + ask:

Deal math (current list): $1.6M ARR expected first year if they hit targets.
Customer requests 30% economic concession tied to MAP milestones (pilot M3 / ramp M6). They prefer rebate-on-achievement structure (not pure upfront).

Why escalate: 30% exceeds delegated discount authority. Customer timeline: needs amendment signed by 5/24. Risk: if we do an upfront deep discount we impact near-term ARR and set a precedent; if we structure as rebate it preserves recognition and gives runway for the customer to prove value.

Proposed internal option to consider (my recommendation):
- Structure: 5% onboarding credit at signing + up to 20% milestone rebates (paid after validated MAP milestones), plus a 5% performance tranche contingent on 12-month sustained usage. Total economics = 30% if all milestones hit.
- Payment profile: rebates paid quarterly post-validation; require usage telemetry + audit right.
- Safeguard: clawback if they churn before 12 months; cap on rebate to protect revenue.

Attachments: Verta_MAP_v1.3.pdf (MAP + metrics), discount_term_sheet.xlsx (proposed schedule).

Ask: Can finance/CFO sign the structure? Anything here that blocks legal or finance recognition? I need a decision to get DocuSign amendment out.

Thanks — Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: discount_term_sheet.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount — need exec approval

Olga / team —

I like the rebate-forward approach; preserves recognition and aligns to outcomes. My practical suggestion to avoid giving 30% upfront: offer 20% economic concession guaranteed + additional 10% paid only when M6 ramp verified (so 10% is truly at-risk). That reduces our exposure and gives the customer runway.

If finance confirms we can structure as a deferred rebate with a clear audit and repayment clause, I'm supportive. Pushing timeline makes sense; let's aim to get CFO note today so we can prepare an amendment.

Ben
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount — need exec approval

Agree with Ben. This is a strategic logo; worth being flexible but we need guardrails. Finance: can you confirm the allowable structure for a rebate (accounting treatment + clawback language)? Also need legal to add an audit clause and a maximum cumulative rebate cap.

We should be explicit to the customer that the additional 10% is strictly milestone contingent and that the MAP must include objective telemetry (keys: tokens/month, latency SLA, production sign-off).

If finance confirms we can do 25% (5% onboarding + 20% rebate) without CEO sign-off, propose we move fast. If it requires CEO sign-off for >20%, ask for that now — they want a close by 5/24 and we'll need the signature chain.

Rishi
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount — need exec approval

Team — finance view and recommendation below.

Accounting constraints:
- We prefer rebate-on-achievement (deferred liability) because it preserves near-term revenue recognition; upfront cash credits are harder to reconcile for ARR targets.
- A rebate structure with documented milestones and audit rights is acceptable.

Authorization thresholds:
- Finance can approve up to 20% total economic concession structured as rebate + onboarding credit.
- Anything >20% requires CEO approval due to revenue and precedent risk.

Recommendation to Sales:
- Approve a 25% maximum program but structure as: 5% onboarding credit (applied at T0) + up to 20% milestone rebate paid upon validated achievement (5% after M3; 15% after M6).
- Include a clawback if they terminate within 12 months, and an audit clause with 30-day remediation window.
- Add a rebate cap equal to 110% of committed ARR for protection (example: cannot collect >1.1x committed ARR in rebates).

If Sales wants the total to hit the customer-requested 30%, we need CEO signoff and justification of strategic value.

I can draft a finance memo and the term adjustments; sending a redline to legal now.

Laura Bennett
CFO, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: discount_term_sheet.xlsx (updated) — see sheet 'Finance_approval']

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-17T16:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: VertaLabs request: MAP milestone-linked discount — need exec approval

Thanks — I reviewed Laura's recommendation. I approve moving forward with a maximum of 25% economic concession structured as Laura proposed (5% onboarding credit + up to 20% in milestone rebates). Approve provided we include the following conditions:
- Clear telemetry and acceptance criteria documented in the MAP
- 12-month clawback if they churn or materially undershoot commitments
- Audit rights and remediation window included; legal to add explicit examples of acceptable telemetry sources
- Cap rebate recovery to protect revenue (as Laura suggested)

Do not exceed 25% without additional strategic justification. Olga — please proceed to prepare the amendment and loop legal for final redline. Get DocuSign link ready; I want this closed by 5/24 if terms accepted.

Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clarity on the MAP. Executive update: Redwood has approved a structured concession to align with your ramp, subject to the MAP validation steps and legal redlines. High level (approved):

- Total maximum concession: 25% of contracted value (structured: 5% onboarding credit at signing + up to 20% in milestone rebates).
- Milestone schedule: 5% after pilot completion (M3) upon sign-off; remaining 15% after validated production ramp (M6) when tokens/month threshold is met and telemetry verified.

- Documentation: I will send an amendment (DocuSign) with the redlined discount term sheet and MAP appended. Please review and sign — target close 5/24.

If this sounds acceptable I will circulate the DocuSign link (attached) and the redline for legal/finance review. Thanks for your partnership — excited to accelerate this with VertaLabs.

Best,
Olga Petrov
